source_record.english: Taking life is killing another being Purposely, and without a mistake. Stealing is to take possession of Another's wealth by means of force or stealth. Sexual misconduct, of four types, Engaging in improper kinds of sex. Lying's when the meanings of one's words Are understood, a wrong impression given.

five_grounds.name: language and counterevidence
five_grounds.finding: GTHU is unusual and its complete glossary object carries ewts-warning, while MTHU is the conventional force/power form and the prose expansion351 uses MTHU DBANG. That is positive reason to question spelling, not proof of a corruption. Counterevidence: exact physical/C16 GTHU and the full GTHU glossary explicitly attesting force, with no independently collated corrected same-line witness. Keep this source question LOW/UNCERTAIN and unfiled. GSAD PA/killing and MA BYIN LEN PA/stealing also have exact full lexical records; neither is normalized.
five_grounds.counterevidence: Dictionary attestation may reflect the same underlying source; exact course duplication is not proof of independent publication. Conversely an unusual form or alternate prose spelling alone does not establish a source error. No speculative emendation, hgm_gloss promotion or correction is made.

five_grounds.name: measured limits and boundaries
five_grounds.finding: Eight physical verse lines remain exact; the last has six space-separated written tokens, including contracted BA'O, while the preceding seven have seven. Written-token count alone does not prove a missing syllable or permit inserting GI. Exact C16 and the shared TCS02 extent preserve the same final wording. English capitals mark lineation.
